title: ArborKV: Structure-Aware KV Cache Management for Scaling Tree-based LLM Reasoning
selection_reason: ArborKV couples tree-aware allocation, token-extractive eviction, and lazy rehydration to reduce KV memory for branching reasoning workloads, directly extending KV-cache management for agentic/reasoning serving.
